hold.description: Remain within the encampment; select local cover, dig and shift firing positions.

support.description: Advance on the assigned hill with alternating firing and moving elements.

flank_left.description: Use the left-wing approach; nearby crossfire does not replace the objective.

flank_right.description: Use the right-wing approach; nearby crossfire does not replace the objective.

clear.description: Close on the assigned camp while maintaining spacing and finite ammunition.
